prompt:
Create a finished illustration for a public book-summary library for adult
readers. Use a calm, contemporary illustrated-book style: hand-painted gouache,
soft matte pigment, restrained pencil details, and a subtle warm ivory paper
texture. Use a consistent palette of muted sage and olive green, warm ochre,
natural wood brown, and warm ivory, with dark brown or charcoal details. Keep
saturation restrained and lighting soft and natural. Give the scene generous
breathing room, a clear focal point, and simple, recognizable forms that remain
readable on a phone. When people are relevant, depict believable adults with
natural proportions, respectful expressions, and ordinary clothing. Use the same
medium, palette, texture, and level of detail across the illustration. Avoid
photorealism, glossy 3D, neon colors, cinematic effects, heavy black outlines,
childish clipart, ornamental clutter, and a different art style in each panel.
No readable text, captions, logos, watermarks, fake book covers, or invented
author portraits. Keep all explanations and essential labels outside the
generated image.

Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: square book-summary hero, 1024 by 1024 pixels.
Input image: the supplied spaced-review.webp is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match its matte gouache, pencil detail, ivory paper, soft light and restrained sage, ochre and brown palette. Do not copy its person, desk, room or panel composition.
Subject and composition: a quiet, imagined twentieth-century concert hall rehearsal seen from the back of the small stage. A polished wood cello resting upright in a secure stand is the clear foreground focal point beside a closed grand piano. At the side sits a modest mid-century wooden radio with a plain blank dial. Beyond the stage, a tall window reveals simplified European city rooftops and distant industrial chimneys under an ivory sky. This is one coherent scene, a visual metaphor for orchestral music in contact with public life and broadcast technology. No people, no musical notation, no war imagery, no political emblems. Generous negative space, balanced square crop, all important objects comfortably inside the edges. Keep the instrument recognizable and the scene legible as a small thumbnail. This is an imaginative illustration, not a depiction of a documented performance.
